description: A challenge battery for SELF-GAP PERCEPTION: inputs the agent processes through its real conversation faculties, whose OUTCOME is observable as a substantive result or a known-failure surface (silence / bare social-ack / repair ask-back). The failures feed the self-capability collapse plug; the residual localizes a CapabilityGap to the failing faculty. Every challenge is something the agent is EXPECTED to handle (the battery is its competence self-claim made concrete), so a failure on one is a genuine surprise. A `weak_stub` challenge exercises a deliberately-weak/absent faculty (the synthetic stubbed-to-fail case the current agent needs to have a guaranteed gap, since it handles most real inputs).

challenges.note: the agent's self-organisation reflect faculty -> substantive prose (handled)

challenges.note: a DELIBERATELY-WEAK faculty the agent claims but cannot satisfy: it deflects to a bare social-ack instead of a substantive account -> the residual localizes a CapabilityGap here (the external-dev Vane-conversation gap, made a battery item).
